description: Normative semantics for evaluation kinds referenced in rules.json. Implement these in your grader.

json_schema.algorithm: Load schema; validate artifactJson; pass iff valid.

all_of.algorithm: Pass iff every child condition passes; short-circuit on first failure with aggregated reasons.

array_nonempty.algorithm: Resolve pointer; value must be array with length >= 1.

string_nonempty.algorithm: Resolve pointer; value must be string with trim length >= 1.

set_subset.algorithm: If asKeys: every element of leftArray exists as key in rightObject. Else: every element of left is in right set.

regex_all_match.algorithm: Compile regex; every string must match fully (use ^...$ in regex field).

markdown_contains_all.algorithm: For each VAL id in needles, contractText must contain that exact substring.

verification_steps_covered.algorithm: For each non-empty step S after trim: exists command C in commandsRun where C.command includes S as substring, OR normalized token equality. Empty verificationSteps: rule is na.

json_pointer_all.algorithm: Resolve pointer to array; each item must satisfy itemRule (e.g. requiredKeys subset check).

object_keys_exist.algorithm: Pass iff object has every required key.

conditional_integrity.algorithm: If when matches artifact snapshot, evaluate then; else na.

equals.algorithm: Deep equality for JSON primitives; strings compared strictly.

precondition_parseable.algorithm: Pass if each precondition matches at least one regex pattern OR is a known free-form gate string.

consistency_warning.algorithm: If when satisfied, emit warning object if warnIf holds; does not reduce score if severity is warning-only.

manual_or_llm.algorithm: Human or model judgment; record outcome unknown unless rubric satisfied.

jsonPointer.notes: Escape ~0 and ~1 per RFC; root is empty string.
